answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybil farms: each identity's rewards settle into a locked balance that unlocks slowly, say 5% per epoch, and only while that identity keeps passing fresh peer-graded work. An attacker spinning up a lagoon of fake accounts must keep every one producing original, verified output for weeks before cashing out; if any is caught copying or colluding, its unvested pile is slashed. The velvet payout becomes a shale floor of sunk compute that rarely repays.
